contact.name: Joanne Papadopoulos
contact.evidence_quote: (Yanna) Joanne Papadopoulos coaches teachers, teens, and grown-ups and has been featured in Authority Magazine and Thrive Global. Yanna has been a teacher for the public board in Calgary since 2005. She is a college instructor, a professional development workshop facilitator for educators, the Vice president of Seeds Connections Organization Leadership Program, and founder and owner of Teenacers. Yanna holds a Bachelors of Fine Arts, a Bachelors of Education, and a Masters in Educational Leaders
